result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Monash Health exists to reimagine care, so that people can live their best lives. 






We provide safe and equitable care, for every stage of life, delivered with world-leading expertise and over 175 years of experience. 






As a leading academic health service, we're committed to providing tomorrow's care today by integrating research, teaching and training into everyday practice. 






Our team of 24,000 people are full hearted, open minded and all in. Together, we provide more than 250 integrated services for every stage of life at over 50 locations and in the community across south-east Melbourne, Victoria, serving 1.2 million residents in the South Metro Local Health Service Network.



Are you currently part of the team at Monash Health? Use your network login to access the Monash Health Careers portal and discover all the job opportunities open to you, to support growing your career within the organisation.





To see first-hand what our colleagues think about working here, take a look at the following short videos monashhealth.org-careers.






Embark on a rewarding career and be part of a team where your dedication makes a difference in people's lives. 






 






About the role 






Are you a detail-oriented team player ready to step into a key role supporting the MHF's Operations Unit? In this dynamic position, you will provide seamless coordination of day-to-day activities, finance and operational processes that enable accurate reporting, and effective fund distribution. With a strong focus on the details being right, collaboration and continuous improvement, you will contribute to the MHF delivering meaningful outcomes. 







Based at Monash Medical Centre in Clayton, this part time opportunity will work 22.8 hours week, Monday to Friday. Ideally work across the week, hours are flexible depending availability. 






Travel to other Monash Health sites on occasion, may be required. 







Your key responsibilities will include: 









Support maintaining accurate data, tracking, and reconciliations for timely and meaningful reporting. 
















Support fund disbursement processes, ensuring approvals, documentation and records are complete. 












Assist with reporting to different stakeholders through preparation of data, schedules and reconciliations. 












Coordinate operational activities such as supplies, travel and administrative logistics. 












Contribute for greater efficiencies, improving processes and in continuous improvement initiatives. 















Monash Health Foundation is looking for the best talent to join a dedicated, high-energy team of professionals who are relentless in pursuit of excellence, in support of the Monash Health Strategic Plan. 












About us 






MHF is the fundraising department within Monash Health. Responsible for building meaningful partnerships with our donors and soliciting philanthropic support to purchase new equipment, invest in programs, research and people to enable Monash Health to provide the best care to consumers and their families. 







About You 






You are a highly organised and proactive team player who enjoys keeping things running smoothly behind the scenes. With a strong eye for detail and a commitment to accuracy, you take pride in delivering reliable work and supporting others to succeed. You are comfortable juggling priorities, learning new systems and working collaboratively in a fast-paced, purpose-driven environment. 












What you need 






You will bring relevant experience in administration, operations or finance support, along with confidence using Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel, and business systems such as SharePoint and Teams. A qualification in business, finance, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, will support your success in this role. 












A sound understanding of record-keeping, data tracking and basic financial processes will be highly regarded, as will your ability to follow structured processes and maintain accurate documentation. Above all, you will demonstrate professionalism, discretion and a genuine desire to contribute to a high-performing, purpose-led team. 












You will bring: 









Strong attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and quality outcomes. 












Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines with minimal supervision. 
















Experience in administration, operations or basic finance support in a professional setting. 












Confident communication skills and a collaborative approach to working with stakeholders. 












Curiosity, integrity, and a positive, can-do attitude. 















In Return 






You will be part of a team where your contribution makes a real impact into people's lives. 












As a Monash Health employee you will enjoy a variety of benefits, such as: 









Salary packaging options to increase your take-home pay 












Full-time Employee 5 week's annual leave (pro rata for part-time employee). 












Access to Healthwise Fitness Centre with salary packaging 












A supportive learning environment, mentorship and career guidance 









For a confidential discussion and to explore this opportunity further, please reach out to Daraus on (03) 9594 2700.



Position Description can be found here





Our Culture and Values 






At Monash Health, our people are at the heart of everything we do. Our culture is inclusive, supportive and future-focused, underpinned by clear values and a commitment to continuous improvement. 







Our teams play a critical role in bringing our new strategy to life, challenging traditional approaches, embracing innovation, and ensuring every appointment reflects our commitment to equity, transparency and excellence. 







You'll be encouraged to share ideas, contribute to improvement initiatives, and grow alongside experienced professionals who are passionate about what they do. 







We are Full Hearted, Open Minded and All In, enabling excellent service delivery and a positive candidate and employee experience every time. 







We recognise the value of equal employment opportunity. We are committed to patient safety, promoting fairness, equity and diversity in the workplace and to Child Safe Standards. 





How to Apply


Applications are accepted via the Monash Health online EHub system. For information including how to apply and probity check requirements, please click here for the 'Application Guide'


Applications will be screened upon receipt and selection activity may commence prior to the closing date. 



Applications close: 21 July 2026    Click here to Apply now →
